notes.title: Major content update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks for all your feedback and comments! Considering them, I decided to make changes to the game. They are all optional.

 Random levels. A sequence of eight procedurally generated levels. Each level will have at least one torch. Random levels will be unlocked after completing the main game.

[previewyoutube=7DLaKY-zCr8;full]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7DLaKY-zCr8[/previewyoutube]

 Classic ball control mode. Now you can adjust the bounce angle with a paddle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38036693/9effdc325e83dae21ae96b10634aaf29c8898741.png

  "More robots" mode. Now there are more enemies. In random levels too. (+3 ammo from Bob)

 "Random levels without enemies" mode. Removes aggressive robots from random mode. Bogies and bombs remain. Disables bonus from "More robots" mode :)

 Option "No bonuses from achievements". This disables permanent bonuses.

 Minor decorative changes.
